title: The Thorn of Caerlum
author: Noor Delacroix
blurb: Marguerite Hartwell, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
